shadows.name: active-nav-marker
shadows.purpose: Marks the active desktop navigation item; the narrow layout uses an inset bottom marker.

motion.name: control-state
motion.value: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Button hover state transitions; reduced-motion mode minimizes transition duration.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt action used for the primary form or item decision.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.7rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--cobalt); border-radius: 0; color: white; background: var(--cobalt); font: inherit; font-weight: 680; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { color: white; background: var(--cobalt-dark); border-color: var(--cobalt-dark); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary item action without a filled resting surface.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 2.7rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-weight: 680; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--cobalt-dark); background: var(--cobalt-light); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-quiet:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square, labeled field used for URL capture, search, and metadata.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Docket Slip
components.description: Ruled link record with source/date context and explicit state actions.
components.html:
RSS feed

Open original ↗
components.css: .ds-docket { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-dark); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); background: rgb(255 254 249 / 82%); } .ds-docket-rule { width: 2.7rem; height: 0.22rem; background: var(--signal); } .ds-docket-body { padding: 0.95rem 1rem 1.05rem; } .ds-source-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 1.45rem; padding: 0.12rem 0.42rem; color: white; background: var(--cobalt); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-docket h2 { margin: 0.55rem 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: clamp(1.16rem, 1.6vw, 1.48rem); } .ds-docket h2 a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-docket h2 a:hover { color: var(--cobalt); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-docket a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Cobalt-rail item with a signal-gold inset active marker.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.85rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 13%); color: #dbe5e8; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: white; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 8%); } .ds-nav-active { color: white; background: #245c80; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--signal); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Organization Mark
components.description: Square collection or tag label attached to a saved link.
components.css: .ds-tag-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 1.65rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.48rem; color: var(--cobalt-dark); background: var(--cobalt-light); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-tag-mark.ds-collection-mark { color: var(--ink); background: #e9c45b; }

components.name: Feed Health Indicator
components.description: Outlined circle communicates feed status alongside status text.
components.css: .ds-health-indicator { display: inline-block; width: 0.7rem; height: 0.7rem; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-health-good { color: var(--good); background: var(--good); } .ds-health-warning { color: var(--error); background: var(--error); } .ds-health-pending { color: var(--pending); background: transparent; }

narrative.overview:
Marginalia uses a daylight receiving-register language: a cobalt navigation rail, chalk work surface, ruled docket slips, and signal-gold marks. Source and date stay legible beside each link; Inbox items receive an individual Save or Dismiss decision.

The register stores link metadata and organization, not article pages or imagery. Keep article language plain and use the original site as the reading destination.
keyCharacteristics: Source and publication date remain explicit on each docket.
Ruled strips and stamped state marks organize the interface.
Controls and panels use squared corners.
dos: Do preserve source identity, date, and individual item actions in docket-based lists.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, a skip link, labeled fields, and responsive navigation and controls; WCAG 2.2 AA is the confirmed accessibility target, not a claim of audited conformance.
Do use status text alongside color indicators.
donts: Don't imply that Marginalia archives article bodies or images; reading stays on the original website.
Don't turn Inbox review into bulk disposition; the selected direction is one explicit decision per item.
Don't add unconfirmed logos, imagery, or alternate visual identities.
